emerging_threats.name: University-affiliated housing data tools
emerging_threats.why_it_matters: Campus-operated locator and housing data tools could improve and reduce perceived need for outside research.

positioning_gaps.description: Local Auburn leasing managers need campus-specific renter behavior and messaging guidance, not national investor dashboards.
Operators need action-ready briefs and recommendations, not just raw dashboards or large data platforms.
A behavioral-intelligence and student-voice product is different from property-finance intelligence.

market_saturation_rationale: There are established intelligence vendors, but they are broad, enterprise, and often investor-oriented. The Auburn-specific leasing intelligence wedge is still relatively open.
